message.content: I’m not aware of any dedicated “pet‑friendly” train stations in Miami—train stations themselves don’t typically have pet‑friendly policies. However, if you’re looking to travel by train, the main Amtrak station in Miami (at 1 NW 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33128) does allow pets on the trains (subject to Amtrak’s pet policy). If you need a station that specifically accommodates pets on-site (e.g., pet‑friendly waiting areas), I’m afraid there isn’t one in Miami. Let me know if you’d like more details about Amtrak’s pet policy or alternative transportation options.
